headline: Dualith base worker
title: Dualith | Mining Six Transport Six And Rideable | Palworld Guide
video_script: Dualith is a Ground and Grass Pal in Palworld one point zero, and it does more than one job. It has Mining level six and Transporting level six, plus Lumbering level five. You can also ride it with a Dualith Saddle, and its partner skill, Forest Laser, fires a Grass laser. An alpha waits on the Isle of Circular Ruins. Will you build a team? Comment below!
description: Dualith in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Ground and Grass Pal with Mining level six and Transporting level six.
